title: Home Protection Plans Claim Settlement: Payout, Sub-Limits and the Contractor Service Fee
content:
This rule fixes what a plan in the Home Protection Plans line pays on an approved claim and what the customer pays the network contractor.

## Payout on an approved repair

The payout on an approved repair is the smallest of three amounts:

- the contractor's cost of the covered work (the repair cost);
- the plan's per-claim cap; and
- the plan's annual coverage cap less the plan-year payouts so far, where the plan-year payouts so far are the total of the payouts on the plan's approved claims in the plan year containing the failure date.

## Replacement, surge damage, permits and code upgrades

- Replacement of a unit is paid only when the plan allows replacement, and up to the plan's replacement cap.
- Surge damage to electronics is paid up to the plan's surge electronics cap.
- Permits and code upgrades are paid up to the plan's code-upgrade cap.

Each of these is paid within the same caps: the per-claim cap and the annual coverage cap less the plan-year payouts so far still limit the amount.

## Amounts the customer pays the contractor

- **Service fee.** The customer pays the plan's service fee per visit to the contractor, except on an included tune-up when the plan waives the service fee on included tune-ups, and on a return visit for the same failure within the plan's repeat-visit fee waiver period of the earlier claim, that is, within that many calendar days after the earlier covered repair.
- **Costs above a cap.** Repair costs above a cap are paid by the customer directly to the contractor.

## Contractors outside the network

Repairs by contractors outside the network are not reimbursed when the plan does not reimburse out-of-network repairs.

## Worked examples (hypothetical plan figures: per-claim cap $1800.00, annual coverage cap $4000.00)

| Case | Repair cost | Plan-year payouts so far | Annual cap less payouts so far | Payout (smallest of the three) | Paid by the customer to the contractor above the cap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | $900.00 | $0.00 | $4000.00 | $900.00 | $0.00 |
| B | $2300.00 | $0.00 | $4000.00 | $1800.00 | $500.00 |
| C | $1600.00 | $2900.00 | $1100.00 | $1100.00 | $500.00 |

In case C the two earlier approved payouts in the plan year, $1200.00 and $1700.00, total $2900.00; $4000.00 less $2900.00 leaves $1100.00, which is smaller than both the repair cost and the per-claim cap. Any service fee due for the visit is payable in addition.

## Return visit illustration (hypothetical 30-day waiver period)

- Return visit for the same failure 20 days after the earlier covered repair: no service fee.
- Return visit for the same failure 45 days after the earlier covered repair: the service fee applies.
